package.name: aav_sim_models
package.description: Ravensim's Python side (Ravensim: our own simulator, aav_simulator): the worlds (empty, test_lot, road) and their models, ravensim.launch.py, and the nodes that put the simulated car behind the same topics as the real one: sim_adapter (/control/sim/actuator_cmd in, from the output mux; /vehicle/odom, status, steering, wheels out), sim_imu, sim_gps, sim_radar, sim_camera_relay, sim_esp32, truth_localizer. And the shared sim models: the actuator model, faults, wheels, the GPS, IMU and radar models, which tools and tests import too.
